fm_reference: FM24 new-game club selection (league tabs, club rows w/ rep, balance, squad strength) + FM multi-nation league structure with cross-league cup and regional scouting networks
biggest_gap: Final league position has zero consequences and the competition structure dead-ends: the table's own zone legend advertises a 'Championship Series (2-4)' and a 'Relegation Zone (14-16)' that are never simulated (grep: the only hit is the legend label in table_tab.gd), and after matchday 30 the header just says 'Season over' — no playoff, no relegation, no rollover into a new season, no champions history. In FM24 every coloured table zone feeds a real mechanism (playoffs, relegation, continental qualification) and the season rolls over with awards and records.
